model_annotation: This plot illustrates the accuracy (ACC) of several methods as a function of co-occurrence number. The x-axis represents "Co-occurrence Number" on a logarithmic scale, ranging from approximately 3 to beyond 3000, with tick marks at 5, 10¹, 10², 10³, and intermediate values. The y-axis represents "ACC (%)" on a linear scale, ranging from 40% to 65%, with tick marks at intervals of 5 percentage points. Six lines are shown, each with distinct colors and markers. The "Base" line (black, circle markers, solid) starts at approximately 38% at a co-occurrence number of ~4, rises gradually, and plateaus around 43.5% at the highest co-occurrence values. The "FT" line (blue, inverted triangle markers, solid) begins near 40% at the lowest co-occurrence number and increases to approximately 47.5% at the highest value. The "IKE" line (red, triangle markers, solid) starts at roughly 43% and rises to approximately 49% at the rightmost point. The "MEND" line (brown, diamond markers, solid) begins at approximately 44.5%, increases to around 48.5% at co-occurrence ~30, then continues rising to approximately 56.5% at the highest co-occurrence number. The "MEMIT" line (purple, pentagon markers, solid) starts near 44% and increases steadily to approximately 55% at the highest co-occurrence value, with an intermediate value of about 51% at co-occurrence ~30. The "ROME" line (green, square markers, solid) starts at approximately 51% at the lowest co-occurrence number, rises to about 57% at ~30, continues to approximately 62% at ~300, and reaches roughly 65.5% at the highest co-occurrence number, making it the highest-performing line across the entire range.
